messages:
Maya (CS): Kicking off SageCrest onboarding. They want a focused 4-week pilot to validate: (A) embed-based KB search in agent UI, (B) AI-suggested reply snippets to deflect repetitive tickets, (C) stable latency under load. Ravi is their PM. Can we align owners and a target timeline?

Ravi (SageCrest): Thanks Maya. Key business goals: 25% ticket deflection, +0.3 NPS lift for support, and maintain p95 <=180ms. We can give a subset of KB (no PII) and sample 3 days of transcripts. Pilot target start: two weeks from now.

Dev (Solutions): I'll own integration + initial prompt set. Plan: week0 access & schema mapping, week1 prototype endpoint + UI hook, week2 embed tuning + retrieval evals, week3 canary + collect metrics. Need to confirm auth method for API keys and whether they want hosted or private routing.

Leo (Eng): I'll handle runtime tuning, caching, and canary strategy. My recommendation: use hosted for prototype, but set up a fallback private route if compliance flag appears. Also will size batching and KV cache once we have qps. Can we get expected concurrent sessions?

Tessa (Enablement): I'll prepare a 60-90m enablement workshop and create an agent playbook and quick troubleshooting runbook. Need two support reps for shadowing during week3 canary.

Ravi (SageCrest): Concurrent sessions: typical 8-12 during business hours, peak 25. We'll confirm exact distribution. We'll also nominate Pri (support SME) for training. No PII in the sample exports.

Maya (CS): Risks: procurement renewal review is in ~45 days which could impact continued pilot. We'll prioritize metrics that map to renewal (deflection and NPS). Also cost note: embedding index size may impact monthly cost; Dev please estimate tokens/calls.

ops-bot: Calendar created: "SageCrest Onboard Kickoff" in 48h with Ravi, Pri, Maya, Dev, Leo, Tessa.

Dev (Solutions): Token/cost rough: prototype ~60k tokens/week, full pilot if heavy retrieval ~200k tokens/week. For now we'll run a sampled eval to keep costs down.

Leo (Eng): Actionable ask for Ravi: send KB export format, average doc length, and a CSV of top-queries. Also confirm whether they'd like embeddings refreshed daily or weekly.

Ravi (SageCrest): I'll send KB export + top queries by EOD tomorrow. Daily refresh is fine for pilot.

Maya (CS): Quick summary to pin here:
```
Owners & ETA:
- Dev: integration + UI prototype (due Day7)
- Leo: runtime sizing + canary plan (due Day10)
- Tessa: enablement session + runbook (due Day18)
- Ravi: KB export + query CSV (due Day1/EOD)
- Maya: pilot dashboard & renewal-linked metrics (due Day3)
Risks: procurement review at Day45 may influence engagement; cost of embeddings if full KB used.
Success Criteria (SageCrest): 25% ticket deflection, +0.3 NPS, p95 <=180ms, embed precision >0.75
```
I'll create a shared tracker and invite owners to update status after kickoff. Ping me if any owner wants to swap. :white_check_mark:
